in_marathi.name: Ajruddin
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Rajas (movement) and Dhan (wealth)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ajruddin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ajruddin is a Sanskrit name derived from two roots, Aj (rajas) and Rudra (Dhan). Rajas signifies movement or dynamic energy, while Dhan represents wealth or abundance. This name is believed to bestow the blessings of both these elements upon the bearer, ensuring a life full of activity and prosperity.
